Description.value: Advazorb Border is an absorbent, atraumatic, self-adhesive bordered dressing with a unique perforated soft silicone wound contact layer. This range is ideal for wounds with low to medium levels of exudate. The silicone wound contact layer has multiple, small 2mm pores which enable the passage of exudate into the absorbent foam whilst protecting the fragile wound bed. This combination ensures the dressings comfortably stay in place whilst minimising the potential for maceration.

Description.value: Wound contact layer antimicrobial 10cm x 10cm

Actilite is a light, viscose net dressing, coated with 99% Manuka honey & 1% Manuka oil. This Manuka honey dressing is designed to protect the wound, promote healing and allow the passage of exudate. The antibacterial effect of Actilite has been enhanced by combining high grade antibacterial Manuka oil with Manuka honey. The combination of Manuka honey and Manuka oil has been demonstrated in-vitro to be effective against a number of major wound infecting organisms including MRSA, VRE and Providentia stuartii. Manuka oil also helps scars and after marks on the skin fade away by promoting new cell growth. Actilite is ideal for granulating and epithelialising wounds ensuring moisture levels remain low to avoid maceration while still providing a moist wound environment optimal for healing. Available in six different sizes, Actilite is designed to effectively cover wounds of all sizes.

sizesAvailable.value: 5cm x 5cm, 10cm x 10cm, 10cm x 20cm, 20cm x 30cm, 30cm x 30cm, 30cm x 60cm

wearTime.value: Depending on clinical observation, dressing may be left in place for up to 7 days. Actilite will be less effective as the honey is diluted by wound exudates, to maintain an effective level change the dressing when the colour changes significantly.
wearTime.source: manufacturer:Advancis Medical (Brightwake)

material.value: light, viscose net dressing, coated with 99% Manuka honey & 1% Manuka oil

indications.value: May be used on all wound types including: Superficial wounds, partial or full thickness wounds, e.g. cuts and abrasions; Pressure ulcers; Leg ulcers; Surgical wounds; Burns; Infected wounds; Graft & donor sites. May assist with debridement if used in conjunction with Activon Tube.

clinicalClaims.value: designed to protect the wound, promote healing and allow the passage of exudate
Manuka oil also helps scars and after marks on the skin fade away by promoting new cell growth

antimicrobial.value: The combination of Manuka honey and Manuka oil has been demonstrated in-vitro to be effective against a number of major wound infecting organisms including MRSA, VRE and Providentia stuartii
antimicrobial.source: manufacturer:Advancis Medical (Brightwake)

contraindications.value: Do not use if patient is allergic to bee venom, bee products or essential oils. Actilite contains glucose. Monitor the levels of patients with diabetes. A few patients experience pain when applied, depending on sensitivity of the wound it may be necessary to consider an appropriate level of analgesia. If pain continues unabated, discontinue use and irrigate the wound with saline solution.

Description.value: Wound contact layer silicone 8cm x 10cm

Silflex is a wound contact, non-adherent dressing made from polyester mesh coated with an atraumatic, hydrophobic soft silicone, making it useful for patients with very thin, friable tissue. Silflex is designed to gently adhere to the skin surrounding a wound and not to the wound bed to reduce the pain and trauma associated with dressing change. With 2mm pore holes Silflex allows the passage of exudate through the dressing. Due to its gentle application and removal, Silflex is an ideal solution for treating and preventing skin tears.

material.value: a cohesive inelastic compression bandage

indications.value: Lower limb conditions where the Ankle Brachial Pressure Index (ABPI) is >= 0.8 - <=1.3; Venous leg ulcers - with and without chronic oedema; Chronic oedema and lymphoedema; Mixed aetiology leg ulcers (ABPI 0.5-0.8) under specialist supervision; Mobile and immobile patients

clinicalClaims.value: applied at 100% full stretch for accurate and easy simple spiral application - reducing the risk of over compression
It delivers high working pressures and lower resting pressures, providing a massaging effect which mimics the action of healthy valves, to reduce venous hypertension and stimulate lymphatic uptake
Effective ulcer healing and oedema reduction
Greater comfort at rest, which improves patient comfort and concordance
Patients can usually wear their normal footwear
The 'Safe-Loc' system aids consistent and accurate application, making team training easier

contraindications.value: Not for use when ABPI <0.5. Not suitable for ankle circumference of less than 18cm unless padding is used to increase the ankle circumference to 18cm or more. Caution is required when cardiac overload is suspected, patients have diabetes, patients have advanced small vessel disease, arterial disease is present, renal failure is present, rheumatoid arthritis is present, or there is known sensitivity to the bandage system. Actico should not be reused. If latex intolerance is suspected, the use of Actico2C or Rosidal K are recommended.

clinicalClaims.value: All the benefits of Actico applied over a skin friendly comfort layer. Applied at 100% full stretch in a simple spiral, reducing the risk of over compression

Description.value: Advazorb is a soft and conformable, low-adherent, hydrophilic, polyurethane foam dressing with a breathable film backing. A non-adherent foam dressing with excellent fluid handling properties, Advazorb is suitable for wounds with low to medium levels of exudate and is ideal for use under compression bandaging with its fluid retention, low profile and low friction film backing. The Advazorb range features a waterproof film backing that prevents strikethrough. The backing has been designed to reduce friction on clothes and bandages which extends dressing wear time by reducing ‘rucking’ and preventing dressings falling off. With a high MVTR the Advazorb foam range provides the ideal conditions for wound healing.

Description.value: Algivon Plus Ribbon is a soft alginate dressing impregnated with 100% medical grade Manuka honey. This Manuka honey dressing creates a moist healing environment and effectively eliminates wound odour whilst providing antibacterial action. Algivon Plus Ribbon has reinforced alginate fibres enabling a sustained, slow release of honey, whilst maintaining the integrity of the dressing. The ribbon is very soft and conformable, shaped for easy application within cavities and sinuses meaning the wound can be easily packed for direct contact with the entire wound site.

wearTime.value: Depending on wound exudate levels, any surrounding fluid, oedema and dressing regime may require changing daily but may be left in place for up to 7 days. Will be less effective as the honey is diluted by wound exudate, to maintain an effective level change the dressing when the colour changes significantly.

contraindications.value: Although the honey is not absorbed into the blood stream, we advise monitoring the levels of blood glucose in patients with diabetes. Do not use if allergic to bee venom. Discomfort can be experienced when honey is applied, depending on sensitivity of the wound it may be necessary to consider an appropriate level of analgesia. The initial discomfort usually subsides, however if it does continue, discontinue use and irrigate the wound with saline solution.

Description.value: Chest Drainage Alivia Percutaneous Drainage Kit The Alivia is a versatile drainage catheter for air and fluid removal in a range of clinical applications, including emergency drainage, superficial drainage, abdominal and pelvic ascites, pneumothorax, and thoracentesis. The 12 cm straight catheter is available in 7Fr, 9Fr, and 12Fr sizes to suit different drainage requirements. Designed for percutaneous use, it supports both gravity and suction-assisted drainage when connected to a collection system. The luer lock handle provides a secure, leak-free connection. An integrated one-way valve enables controlled drainage, prevents backflow, and helps reduce infection risk. The 90° configuration improves handling and eliminates the need for a three-way stopcock. The Veress needle features a green proximal indicator for visual confirmation of correct positioning during insertion, supporting safety and accuracy. 12cm straight catheter available in three sizes: 7Fr, 9Fr and 12Fr. A 90° one-way valve that is continuously active. Verres needle with integrated indicator. Integrated fixing system to minimise dislocation. Streamlined kit includes catheter with one-way valve, Veress needle with indicator, 2000ml drainage bag, mini scalpel and 30ml luer lock syringe.

Description.value: Exudate Management - Advanced Medical Solutions Advanced Medical Solutions Exudate Management Contact Us Exudate management is an essential aspect of chronic wound care. Exudate is the fluid that is present in a wound, and it contains a variety of substances, including blood plasma, white blood cells, nutrients and waste products. Excessive exudate can impair wound healing and increase the risk of infection; insufficient exudate can lead to dehydration of the wound bed and interfere with the formation of new tissue. 1 There are various methods for managing exudate in chronic wounds, and the choice of method will depend on the wound type, location and severity, as well as the patient’s overall health status. 1 Effective exudate management is essential for promoting wound healing and preventing complications in chronic wounds. Description.value: Infection Control - Advanced Medical Solutions Advanced Medical Solutions Infection Control Contact Us Antimicrobial wound dressings play an important role in managing infected wounds by helping to prevent and control bacterial growth. Infected wounds are a serious concern as they can delay healing, increase the risk of complications, and lead to systemic infection. 1 Antimicrobial dressings contain agents such as silver, PHMB or CHG, which have antimicrobial properties and can help to reduce the number of bacteria in the wound bed. These agents work by disrupting the cell membrane of bacteria or by interfering with bacterial replication. 1 In addition to their antimicrobial properties, some types of wound dressings also provide a moist environment that can promote wound healing. For example, foam, fibre or hydrogel dressings can help maintain a moist environment optimal for cell growth and tissue repair. AMS’ range of antimicrobial wound dressings are an important tool in the management of infected wounds, and can help prevent and control bacterial growth, promote healing and reduce the risk of complications. Description.value: Jelpad Blister Plasters are designed to protect and support the healing of blisters caused by friction, pressure, or rubbing from footwear and activity. They are made using hydrocolloid gel , a material commonly used in wound care to maintain a moist healing environment and cushion the affected area. When applied, the plaster forms a soft, flexible layer over the blister. This helps reduce friction and pressure while absorbing fluid from the wound, which supports natural skin repair. Product Features Hydrocolloid gel layer Absorbs blister fluid and helps create a stable environment for healing. Cushioning protection Reduces rubbing and pressure from shoes and movement. Description.value: Vellafilm is a transparent, atraumatic, polyurethane film dressing with Silfix soft silicone adherence. It is designed to protect the wound whilst minimising the pain and trauma associated with dressing change. The soft silicone will adhere to surrounding dry skin but not to a moist wound. The clear film exhibits the optimum moisture vapour transfer rate. The dressing is transparent allowing observation of the wound site or primary dressing minimising dressing change frequency. The film backing acts as a bacterial barrier and has a low coefficient of friction to reduce potential tissue damage from sheer or friction.

wearTime.value: Vellafilm can be left in place for up to 7 days depending on the wound condition.
wearTime.source: manufacturer:Advancis Medical (Brightwake)

material.value: transparent, atraumatic, polyurethane film dressing with Silfix soft silicone adherence

indications.value: Superficial epithelialising wounds and to protect the dermis by reducing sheer and friction. Vellafilm can be used to retain primary wound contact layers and absorbent pads and is particularly suited to patients with friable skin.

clinicalClaims.value: The soft silicone will adhere to surrounding dry skin but not to a moist wound
The clear film exhibits the optimum moisture vapour transfer rate
The dressing is transparent allowing observation of the wound site or primary dressing minimising dressing change frequency

contraindications.value: Do not use if allergic to silicone

Description.value: Wizloc Extrication Collar Designed to fit most adults and many paediatric patients, the reusable Wizloc Extrication Collar is cost effective, simple to use and provides excellent cervical support Standard features include: An accurate fit is enhanced by the adjustable chin and occipital section Designed to be adjusted to the correct size whilst it is on the patient thus ensuring the best possible fit The chin and occipital supports quickly and positively lock into place Openings at the rear and front of the collar promote maximum air circulation and allow access to the neck Supplied with a labelling system to help monitor the number of times the collar is used The Wizloc eliminates the need to invest in a range of different sizes of collar, providing cost savings and saving on storage space Flat packed for simple storage X-Rays may be performed with the collar in place
